value.rationale: The objective is the full kinetic local-minimum landscape on a canonical frustrated fullerene, not a decorative combinatorial count. A threshold at x=1 changes absorbing metastability while the equilibrium ground-state plateau stays unchanged, with a 6710-state weak critical manifold. The face-dual argument explains a structural no-excited-local-minimum property at zero field, and maximal-independent/dissociation correspondences give exact all-field classifications. These provide naturally motivated finite benchmarks for zero-temperature spin dynamics.
